name: event-order
title: DRAFT Banquet event order
for_each: select id,code from events where status<>'cancelled' order by event_date,code

sections.title: Event
sections.sql: select code,name,client,event_date,service_time,venue,guests,status,notes from event_totals where id=$1

sections.title: Menu
sections.sql: select l.name,l.quantity,m.allergens,l.notes from lines l left join menus m on m.id=l.menu_id where event_id=$1 and category in ('food','beverage') order by l.name
sections.note: Allergen labels are recorded information. Confirm ingredients and cross-contact controls with the chef.

sections.title: Dietary instructions
sections.sql: select name,guests,instructions,reviewed_by,reviewed_on from dietary where event_id=$1 order by name

sections.title: Crew
sections.sql: select name,role,start_at,end_at from roster where event_id=$1 order by start_at

name: kitchen-sheet
title: DRAFT Kitchen prep sheet
for_each: select id,code from events where status<>'cancelled' order by event_date,code

sections.title: Event
sections.sql: select code,name,client,event_date,service_time,venue,guests,status,notes from event_totals where id=$1

sections.title: Portions
sections.sql: select l.name,l.quantity,m.allergens,l.notes from lines l left join menus m on m.id=l.menu_id where event_id=$1 and category in ('food','beverage') order by l.name

sections.title: Dietary instructions
sections.sql: select name,guests,instructions,reviewed_by,reviewed_on from dietary where event_id=$1 order by name

name: packing-list
title: DRAFT Dispatch and packing list
for_each: select id,code from events where status<>'cancelled' order by event_date,code

sections.title: Delivery
sections.sql: select code,name,client,event_date,service_time,venue,guests,status,notes from event_totals where id=$1

sections.title: Equipment
sections.sql: select name,quantity,packed,responsible from packing where event_id=$1 order by name

sections.title: Food
sections.sql: select l.name,l.quantity,m.allergens,l.notes from lines l left join menus m on m.id=l.menu_id where event_id=$1 and category in ('food','beverage') order by l.name

name: proposal
title: DRAFT Catering proposal
for_each: select id,code from events where status<>'cancelled' order by event_date,code

sections.title: Event
sections.sql: select code,name,client,event_date,service_time,venue,guests,status,notes from event_totals where id=$1

sections.title: Charges
sections.sql: select name,category,quantity,unit_price_cents,round(quantity*unit_price_cents)::bigint line_cents from lines where event_id=$1 order by category,name

sections.title: Totals
sections.sql: select currency,net_cents,tax_rate,tax_cents,total_cents from event_totals where id=$1
sections.note: Review terms and amounts before issuing. No signature or send action.

sections.title: Payment schedule
sections.sql: select currency,deposit_due,deposit_cents,balance_due from event_totals where id=$1

name: balance-statement
title: DRAFT Balance statement
for_each: select id,code from events where status<>'cancelled' order by event_date,code

sections.title: Event
sections.sql: select code,name,client,event_date,service_time,venue,guests,status,notes from event_totals where id=$1

sections.title: Balance
sections.sql: select currency,total_cents,paid_cents,balance_cents,balance_due from event_totals where id=$1
sections.note: This is a draft statement, not a tax invoice.

sections.title: Receipts
sections.sql: select reference,paid_on,amount_cents from payments where event_id=$1 order by paid_on
sections.note: Receipts are recorded manually. No payment processing.

name: food-safety-record
title: DRAFT Food safety record
for_each: select id,code from events where status<>'cancelled' order by event_date,code

sections.title: Event
sections.sql: select code,name,client,event_date,service_time,venue,guests,status,notes from event_totals where id=$1

sections.title: Observations
sections.sql: select name,mode,temperature_c,exposure_minutes,first_cooling_minutes,second_cooling_minutes,observed_at,operator,corrective_action,jurisdiction from food_logs where event_id=$1 order by observed_at

sections.title: Checks
sections.sql: select name,finding,corrective_action from food_checks where event_id=$1 order by observed_at
sections.note: Evidence screening only. Follow the applicable food control plan and responsible food handler judgement.
